description: This file defines the OverviewTerms class for managing taxonomy term overviews in Drupal, including form building, submission handling, and pagination.

classes.name: OverviewTerms
classes.description: A form class for displaying and managing a tree of taxonomy terms within a vocabulary, supporting drag-and-drop reordering and pagination.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the OverviewTerms object with dependencies and sets up storage and list builder.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the class with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: getFormId
methods.description: Returns the unique form ID for this overview form.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the taxonomy terms overview form with pagination, drag-and-drop, and operation links.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission to update term weights and parent relationships.

methods.name: submitReset
methods.description: Redirects to the reset confirmation form for the vocabulary.
